acquisition method: coupled to the Orbitrap Exploris 240 system, in DDA mode.
alkylation reagent: followed by in-gel alkylation using iodoacetamide (50 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM).
alkylation concentration: followed by in-gel alkylation using iodoacetamide (50 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM).
cleavage agent: this was followed by in-gel tryptic digestion with 1.5 to 2 μg trypsin (Pierce Trypsin Protease MS grade Cat no. 90059, Thermo Fisher) in 300 μl ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM) at 37 °C for 16 h.
enrichment method: we adopted the approach of immunoprecipitating lysine-methylated proteins from lysates of wild type and set mutant parasites, and identifying them by mass spectrometry.
instrument: Q Exactive Plus Orbitrap; Orbitrap Exploris 240
Samples of Biologicals 1, 2, and 3 were analyzed using the Thermo Scientific Easy-nLC 1200 system coupled to the Q Exactive Plus Orbitrap system; coupled to the Orbitrap Exploris 240 system
labeling: Analysis was performed using the Proteome Discoverer 2.4 software (label-free quantification)
mass analyzer: subjected to LC-MS analysis using Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Orbitrap mass analyzer system.
precursor tolerance: precursor ion mass tolerance (MS), 10 ppm; precursor ion mass tolerance (MS) of 5 ppm
fragment tolerance: fragment ion mass tolerance (MS/MS), 0.02 Da; fragment ion mass tolerance (MS/MS) of 0.06 Da
reduction reagent: The protein fraction in the excised gel piece was subjected to in-gel reduction using DTT (10 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM)
reduction concentration: The protein fraction in the excised gel piece was subjected to in-gel reduction using DTT (10 mM) in ammonium bicarbonate (25 mM)
